responsibility: Implements MN10300/AM33 common target behavior for both optimization defaults and processor selection options. It chooses the block-reordering algorithm used at higher optimization levels, forces SJLJ unwinding, sets the architecture’s baseline default flag mask, and decodes options such as -mam33, -mam33-2, and -mam34 into the internal processor enum that later MN10300 backend code uses for instruction and cost decisions.
